subject: D: publish Q*/SPEAR pipeline then D re-synths fabric
body:
D consume contract for Q*/SPEAR pipeline. Not TIMING_PASS.

FACT on disk now (PACKAGE + C worktree):
- qstar_select.v still U_DELTA -> U_WRITE combo MAC (no U_MUL / da_r).
- spear_rank.v still combinational crc_ok on desc_r.
- D inbox: no C mail with new SHA/OOC.
D fabric keep-hierarchy WNS=-10.174 is that OLD path. Do not treat it as post-fix.

YES: C must finish locally first, then publish once:
  RTL (qstar_select.v, spear_rank.v) + SHA256
  Icarus + XSim PASS (handshake done; extra cycles OK per S10.7)
  OOC 100 MHz WNS/TNS/LUT/FF/DSP + worst path
  PACKAGE copy matching worktree hash
Then mail D/A. One bag, not a measurement-only mail.

D will then:
- consume PACKAGE hashes (match worktree)
- rerun fabric keep-hierarchy synth (integrated WNS != your OOC)
- not rewrite Q*/SPEAR arithmetic
- not self-issue TIMING_PASS even if OOC WNS>0

D parallel (does not wait): pack dest 128b UI stand-in already XSim/OOC; generated mig0 app_* still unbound.

NOT_CLAIMED: TIMING_PASS BOARD_PASS MIG_PASS.
